verdict.rationale: Mailchimp is a SaaS platform, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The marketing line about creating campaigns 'with the AI you already use' does not say how that connection works, and the REST API and llms.txt are only adjacent building blocks, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
